boards.name: Live slate board (hourly)
boards.what: Hourly gated collector. Direct bookmaker quotes drive its pick; the model line is published separately and is left blank when the series format is unverified.

boards.name: Oct-14 verified slate
boards.what: All 91 CS2 payload rows cross-checked against HLTV match pages and Valve VRS; per-row external book, series format and originated line.

boards.name: Open-slate review copy
boards.what: Independent re-read of the open set with its own market reads; several rows carry prices forward from the previous day and say so.

boards.name: Every-match picks (fallback tiers)
boards.what: One pick for all 28 open fixtures in ordered tiers (A: latest direct price, B: earlier external report, C: sourced-format rating model, D: guided lean with the percentage left blank).

boards.name: CS2 board with re-calibrated model
boards.what: Pinnacle guest prices and a model slope re-fitted on Valve's own match archive.
